text: The purpose of this report is to recommend City Council adopt a diversity plan for appointments to the Toronto Police Service Board in accordance with the legislative requirement in section 28 of the Community Safety and Policing Act, 2019.

City Council on March 26 and 27, 2025, adopted the following: 1. City Council adopt the Municipal Diversity Plan for appointments to the Toronto Police Service Board in Attachment 1 to the report (March 5, 2025) from the City Clerk. 2. City Council determine that the Toronto Police Service Board be composed of seven members, pursuant to Section 31 (3) of the Community Safety and Policing Act, 2019.
